title: Stewed cockles
html_source:
Cockles are small bivalve mollusks similar to clams.

They are heart-shaped when viewed from a certain angle, perhaps giving rise to the expression “it warmed the cockles of my heart”. It could also be that both terms share a common etymology in the Latin cochleae (“ventricles”).
